similar_in_english: to give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: মা ছেলেকে মুখ করে বলল, 'আবার এমন করলে শাস্তি পাবি।'
শিক্ষক ক্লাসে অলস ছাত্রদের মুখ করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The mother scolded her son, saying, 'If you do that again, you'll be punished.'

note: This idiom reflects everyday verbal discipline in Bengali households, often used in spoken language to denote mild to stern reprimands.
